{{samename|other characters with similar names|Kai}} {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Kye.png|thumb|250px|Kye]] '''Kye''' (Japanese: '''ケン''' ''Ken'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY049|Bonnie for the Defense!]]''. He is part of the self-appointed "{{p|Lapras}} Defense Force", together with [[Heidi]] and [[Jay]]. As part of a running gag, Kye often mispronounces his words, causing him to be corrected by Jay. He and the other members initially disliked grownups, believing them all to be liars. This was because he, Heidi, and Jay once found an abandoned {{p|Eevee}}. They cared for it, but were caught by a teacher. The teacher promised them nothing would happen as long as they were being honest, and after providing an explanation, the teacher took the Eevee away from them. Later, after a thunderstorm occurred, Kye and his friends found traces of something dragging itself through the forest. They followed them and arrived at a lake where they met an injured Lapras. Although it appeared scared at first, the children quickly gained its trust and promised to protect it by forming the Lapras Defense Force. In the present day, Kye and his friends stopped {{an|Bonnie}}, who was taking a stroll through the forest. Although he, Heidi, and Jay did not want anyone to know about Lapras because of the danger of [[Pokémon hunter|Pokémon poachers]], they inadvertently told Bonnie about Lapras when they introduced themselves as the Lapras Defense Force. When Bonnie heard Lapras's cry, they decided to introduce her to it. While the children played, Bonnie noticed Lapras was feverish and suggested the Defense Force get someone to help, but Kye and the others were skeptical and feared for Lapras's safety. They were found by {{Ash}}, {{an|Clemont}}, and {{an|Serena}}, who echoed Bonnie's concerns that they get [[Nurse Joy]] to help Lapras recover. Kye, Heidi, and Jay start crying out of guilt, and they decided to call in Nurse Joy. Nurse Joy healed Lapras and informed the children that the Eevee their teacher had taken away from them had been brought back safely to its Trainer, causing Kye and the others to rethink their opposition to adults. After healing, Lapras started to cry out to the sky, and Clemont figured it had been separated from its friends, who were likely out at sea. After Bonnie had a word with the Lapras Defense Force, they decided that if they really loved Lapras, they would return it to its natural habitat. Later, he, Heidi, Jay, and Bonnie returned Lapras to sea safely while Ash, Clemont, and Serena battled {{TRT}}. The Lapras Defense Force said goodbye to Lapras as reunited with its friends and hoped they would meet it again someday. The day after, he, Heidi, and Jay said goodbye to Ash and his friends. He reappeared in a flashback in ''[[XY140|Till We Compete Again!]]''. ==Pokémon== ===Befriended=== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kye |pkmn=Lapras |type1=Water |type2=Ice |img=Lapras XY049.png |epnum=XY049 |epname=Bonnie for the Defense! |desc=Kye, [[Heidi]], and [[Jay]] discovered {{p|Lapras}} in a lake and found out it was hurt. They befriended it and swore to treat it and protect it, even establishing the "Lapras Defense Force". Much later, they also introduced it to {{an|Bonnie}}, who also became friends with it. After playing with Lapras, the children discovered its body was feeling hot and deduced it had not properly recovered from its wound. It was briefly treated by {{an|Clemont}}, but he suggested they should bring a [[Nurse Joy]] as Lapras had a serious fever. Nurse Joy arrived and quickly made Lapras recover. After healing, Lapras started to cry out for the sky. Clemont figured it wanted to return to its friends in the sea. Although the children were initially against the idea of letting Lapras return to its natural habitat, they decided that if they really loved it, they would help in returning it. Moments later, {{TRT}} appeared, wanting to steal Lapras. While {{Ash}}, Clemont, and {{an|Serena}} fought them, the Lapras Defense Force including Bonnie ensured Lapras was guided safely to the sea. Although it got confused by [[James's Inkay]]'s {{m|Psybeam}}, Heidi made it remember the good times they had with it. After this, its friends quickly came to help it and froze Team Rocket with {{m|Ice Beam}}. Afterwards, Lapras said goodbye to the Lapras Defense Force as it returned to sea with it friends. It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[XY140|Till We Compete Again!]]''. Lapras's only known move is {{m|Water Gun}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{water color}}|bordercolor={{ice color light}} |ja=大原桃子 ''Momoko Ōhara'' |fi=Katja Sirkiä |it=Patrizia Mottola |pl=Grzegorz Drojewski |es_la=Fernando Calderón |es_eu=Blanca Rada}}
